summary: Frontend-only testing of the new SVG body silhouette (male + female, front + back) for all 5 disease encounter flows. All 9 review items functionally verified after fixing one critical store bug. Default sex correctly follows patient sex (P-2026-001001 -> Male, P-2026-001002 -> Female), Male/Female buttons switch figure, Front/Back buttons render 17 regions per view (5 center + 6 L + 6 R) with the exact labels required by the spec (Head/face, Neck, Chest, Abdomen, Groin/genital, Scalp, Neck (back), Upper back, Lower back, Buttocks, and L/R upper arm, forearm, hand/palm, thigh, leg/calf, foot/sole). Hover highlights only the hovered path (CSS .silhouette-region:hover fills #0f52ba + drop-shadow). Selecting a code then clicking a region turns the path red (.marked -> #dc2626), overlays the code letters via body-mark-<slug>, and appends a row in the lesion-list with region, view, and code description. Clicking the same region + same code toggles the mark off. Disease-specific codes verified: Scabies B/P/V/PU/C/E/NO, Leprosy PT/N/CL/BL/UL/NO, LF S1-S7, Buruli PA/PN/PPl/O/NU, Yaws T/U/P/J/BC/NO. LF per-lesion Secondary infection buttons (None/Acute/Mild/Chronic) and Buruli Category 1-3 render inline in the lesion-list. Front and back marks are stored as separate keys (front:Chest vs back:Upper back). Save + reopen via ?enc=<id> restores marks in both views and the patient record shows the tagged regions under the condition tab. Mobile 390x844 has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390).

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky bottom action bar (Save / Save & close) overlaps the SVG silhouette at desktop viewport ~1000px tall. After scroll_into_view of the small forearm/hand paths (y bottom ~999px), elementFromPoint at those coordinates returns the footer DIV instead of the SVG path, so real mouse clicks on right/left forearm and hand can miss. JS dispatchEvent works, confirming the handler is fine and the overlap is what blocks the pointer. Fix suggestion: add bottom padding to the encounter scroll container (or main) equal to footer height, or make the silhouette card scroll-margin-bottom = footer height.

issues: Requirement text mentions '21-22 clickable regions per view' but the actual (and documented in the requirement's own list) count is 17 per view (5 center + 6 L + 6 R). All named regions are present; the 21-22 number appears to be a requirement typo.

action_items: Prevent the sticky footer from covering the silhouette so forearm/hand/foot regions remain clickable at every scroll position (add bottom safe-area padding to the encounter main container or reduce silhouette max height on desktop).
Confirm the intended region count target (17 vs 21-22) with product; if 21-22 is intended, add regions such as separate hip/knee/wrist/ankle/shoulder.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: /app/frontend/src/store.js saveEncounter() built a new record with `{ id: <random>, ..., ...enc }`. For new encounters enc.id is undefined, and object spread of `{id: undefined}` overwrites the generated id with undefined. Every newly-saved encounter therefore had id === undefined, which made ?enc=<id> reopen fail (existing not found -> draft resets, marks disappear) and made the record invisible in the patient record's condition tab. Fixed by destructuring `{ id: _dropId, ...rest } = enc` and spreading `rest` instead.

Pre-existing (out of this task's scope): React key warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of PatientRecord.' — noticed while opening the patient record after save. Should be addressed by main agent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 9 review items work after the store.js fix

context_for_next_testing_agent: Body silhouette is SVG-based. Regions use testids body-region-<slug of the LABEL shown to the user>. Front labels: head-face, neck, chest, abdomen, groin-genital, right/left upper-arm, forearm, hand, thigh, leg, foot. Back labels: scalp, neck-back, upper-back, lower-back, buttocks, right/left upper-arm-back, forearm-back, palm, thigh-back, calf, sole. Marks are keyed 'front:<Label>' / 'back:<Label>' in encounter data.marks. saveEncounter generates ENC-<id> only if enc.id is falsy after the fix in store.js. IMPORTANT for Playwright: at desktop 1400x1000 viewport, when scrolling forearm/hand into view the sticky footer overlaps them; use `dispatch_event('click')` or click chest/upper-arm instead if you just need to exercise the mark flow. On mobile 390x844 the forearm is mid-viewport and clicks fine.
rca of the issue: 1) Marks not persisting on reopen: root cause was JS object spread of `{id: undefined, ...}` overwriting the freshly generated ENC-xxx id in store.saveEncounter. Because id ended up undefined, both the encounter list and the ?enc=<id> lookup could not find it, so Encounter.jsx fell back to the empty draft and marks appeared to disappear after save. Reproduction: log in as admin, open /patients/P-2026-001001/encounter/scabies, expand section 3, tag any region, click Save, inspect localStorage 'trias.state.v1' -> the last encounter's id is undefined. Mitigation: destructure enc to drop id before spreading (applied). 2) Small forearm/hand paths cannot receive real mouse clicks at desktop 1000px viewport height because the sticky bottom Save bar overlaps them after scroll_into_view. Reproduction: at 1400x1000, expand section 3, page.mouse.click at bounding-box center of body-region-right-hand -> no mark. Confirmed via document.elementFromPoint returning the footer div. Mitigation: add bottom padding to encounter container OR reduce silhouette height so lower body clears the sticky footer at min supported height.
